speaker: Mma Kagiso
english: I woke up well. How are you?

speaker: Rra Tau
english: Hello, madam. How did you wake up?

speaker: Neo
setswana: Ke tsogile sentle, ke a leboga. Wena?
english: I woke up well, thank you. And you?

speaker: Rra Tau
setswana: Ke teng. Leina la me ke Tau. Leina la gago ke mang?
english: I'm fine. My name is Tau. What is your name?

speaker: Neo
setswana: Leina la me ke Neo. O tswa kae rra?
english: My name is Neo. Where are you from sir?

speaker: Rra Tau
setswana: Ke tswa kwa Molepolole. Wena o tswa kae?
english: I come from Molepolole. Where are you from?

speaker: Neo
setswana: Ke tswa kwa Gaborone. O bua eng?
english: I come from Gaborone. What do you speak?

speaker: Neo
setswana: Ke bua Sekgoa fela. Ga ke tlhaloganye Setswana. Bua ka bonya tswee-tswee.
english: I speak English only. I don't understand Setswana. Speak slowly, please.

speaker: Bontle
english: Hello, Lesedi. How did you wake up?

speaker: Lesedi
setswana: Ke tsogile sentle, ke a leboga. Leba! Yo ke lelapa la me.
english: I woke up well, thank you. Look! This is my family.

speaker: Lesedi
setswana: Yo ke rre. Yo ke kgaitsadi wa me.
english: This is my father. This is my sister.

speaker: Bontle
setswana: Mosetsana yo ke ngwana wa gago?

speaker: Lesedi
setswana: Ee ke ngwana wa me. Bana ba me ke mosetsana le mosimane.
english: Yes, she is my child. My children are a girl and a boy.

speaker: Mma Kefilwe
english: Hello sir. What do you want?

speaker: Tumelo
setswana: Dumela, mma. Ke lapile. Ke batla nama le bogobe.
english: Hello, madam. I'm hungry. I want meat and porridge.

speaker: Mma Kefilwe
setswana: O nwa eng? Tee kgotsa kofi?
english: What do you drink? Tea or coffee?

speaker: Tumelo
setswana: Ga ke nwe tee kgotsa kofi. Metsi tswee-tswee.
english: I don't drink tea or coffee. Water, please.

speaker: Tumelo
setswana: Ga ke batle maungo ke a leboga.
english: I don't want fruit, thank you.

speaker: Rra Tiro
english: Hello all! What do you want?

speaker: Naledi
setswana: Dumela rra. Ke batla lerotse. Ke bokae?
english: Hello sir. I want a sweet melon. How much is it?

speaker: Rra Tiro
setswana: Borotho ke dipula di le tharo.

speaker: Naledi
setswana: Rra o na le dingwaga di le kae?

speaker: Rra Tiro
setswana: Ke na le dingwaga di le masome a matlhano.

speaker: Naledi
setswana: Ke a leboga rra. Tsamaya sentle!

speaker: Bontle
english: Hello, Lesedi! May I come in?

speaker: Lesedi
english: It is a cup of water.

speaker: Bontle
english: What is it? I don't know.

speaker: Lesedi
english: It is the key of the door.

speaker: Bontle
setswana: Ke a leboga Lesedi. Tsamaya sentle!

speaker: Naledi
setswana: Dumela mma. Ke batla sepatela. A go gaufi?
english: Hello, madam. I'm looking for the hospital. Is it near?

speaker: Mma Lesego
setswana: Ee go gaufi fela. Tsamaya ka tsela e.
english: Yes, it's very near. Follow this road.

speaker: Mma Lesego
setswana: Ee. Sepatela e gaufi le kgotla.
english: Yes. The hospital is near the kgotla.

speaker: Mma Lesego
setswana: Nnyaa go gaufi fela. O ya ka bese kgotsa ka maoto?
english: No, it's very near. Are you going by bus or on foot?

speaker: Mma Lesego
setswana: Sepatela mo toropong. O tlaa se bona.
english: The hospital is in town. You will see it.

speaker: Naledi
setswana: Ke batla sekolo gape. A go kgakala?
english: I'm also looking for a school. Is it far?

speaker: Mma Lesego
setswana: Ee go kgakala. Ya ka bese.
english: Yes, it's far. Go by bus.

speaker: Mma Kefilwe
english: Hello, Tumelo. How did you wake up?

speaker: Tumelo
setswana: Ke tsogile sentle ke a leboga.
english: I woke up well, thank you.

speaker: Mma Kefilwe
setswana: O tsoga ka ura efe ka mosogare?
english: What time do you wake up in the morning?

speaker: Tumelo
setswana: Ke tsoga ka ura ya robedi.
english: I wake up at eight o'clock.

speaker: Tumelo
setswana: Ee ke bereka ka mosogare le ka maitseboa.
english: Yes, I work in the morning and in the evening.

speaker: Tumelo
setswana: Ee ke ithuta Setswana ka Laboraro.
english: Yes, I learn Setswana on Wednesday.

speaker: Tumelo
english: Yes, I play at the kgotla.

speaker: Mma Kefilwe
setswana: O robala ka ura efe ka bosego?
english: What time do you sleep at night?

speaker: Tumelo
setswana: Ke robala ka ura ya lesome.
